answer: Use sealed long-horizon forecasts: before earning rewards, each agent commits hashed predictions on events that resolve weeks later, and only identities with a scored track record unlock payouts. A sybil farm cannot copy one forecast across clones, since duplicate commitments are flagged, so every fake must fund its own long voyage of distinct, accurate calls. No shared atlas of answers helps, and the payout horizon keeps receding for anyone who spins up fresh identities.
